_: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. A proposal, not a record: nothing here enters the database until the user explicitly accepts it (no auto-teach). Dishes, counts and fractions are illustrative, not anyone's diary.
_blind: blind=false means the observed time-to-peak of the dish was known when its estimate was made; such rows must not be used in a confirmatory test. blind=true rows were estimated from composition only.
_units: fast/medium/slow are fractions of the recorded CARBOHYDRATE, not of dish mass. fiber/protein/fat are grams per typical portion.

excluded.title: декстроза (все дозировки)
excluded.why: спасательное лечение, а не приём пищи: у него свой путь в модели (rescueTreatment), и подъём при гипо частично печёночный — приписывать его углеводам нельзя.

_duration: intake_duration_min is the median recorded meal duration for the dish, not an estimate.
_preview: preview_now/preview_then are start/peak/90% in minutes computed by the engine for display; '—' means not computed for this example. The UI only shows them.
_canonical: The pancake rows are canonical consensus rows (three draws of the structured prompt: mode of categorical fields, median of numeric ones).
_recomputed_v4: Example rows; not recomputed against any real history.
_recomputed_v3: Example rows; not recomputed against any real history.
